rigAudit.verification: Exact names read from downloaded character GLB node lists, confirmed in Knight FBX binary strings and the Unity source-import probe at artifacts/kaykit-source-probe.txt.

animationAudit.verification: Current Windows/WebGL builds and native preview passed: Knight Idle_A and horizontal sword slice, Ranger aiming/release, actual Draw-derived release direction and reversed-grip negative control.
animationAudit.crossbowNote: Historical source audit only: crossbow actions are no longer selected for Knight. Retained source files and earlier derived clips are not used by the current sword/shield controller.

normalizationPlan.character: Preserve shared Generic rig, turn root motion off, normalize visible bounds to approximately 1.4 world units, and anchor feet at y=0.
normalizationPlan.weapons: Sword in handslot.r and shield in handslot.l for Knight. Ranger bow stays in handslot.l with local Z rotated 180 degrees to correct Unity's mirrored bow release direction. Verify grip visually in idle, movement and attack; source FBX files remain unchanged.
normalizationPlan.bowDirectionVerification: The earlier fixed local +X test used the wrong sign. Current verification derives release direction from the negative of the actual imported Draw blendshape displacement, checks forward +Z, and rejects the old reversed grip as a negative control. Source audit is in artifacts/bow-source-audit.py and .json.
normalizationPlan.projectile: Ranger only: simulation radius 0.18 unchanged; visible arrow length 0.68, rendered height 0.68, local tip at +0.18 and tail about -0.50. Knight uses authoritative melee events and never creates arrows.
normalizationPlan.material: Current source atlas assignments: Knight, sword_1handed and shield_badge use knight_texture; Ranger, bow_withString and arrow_bow use ranger_texture. Unused crossbow_1handed/rogue_texture are retained as historical source files.

editHistory.change: Acquired official free archives, preserved license files, selected only Knight/Ranger/equipment and three medium-rig animation exports. Source FBX/PNG files copied without modification; Unity normalization performed by the project build pipeline.

Generated equipped Generic prefabs at 1.4-unit standing height, palette materials and controllers. Normalized sideways one-hand aiming/shooting using derived .anim copies; original sources unchanged. Arrow length 0.68, tip at local +0.18, rendered height 0.68; runtime pools preserve source scale and palette.

User reported reversed bow and requested true melee. Source FBX geometry/Draw audit identified Unity X-axis mirroring; corrected bow grip with local Z 180 degrees and replaced the incorrect fixed +X check with deformation-derived direction plus reversed-grip negative control. Knight changed from crossbow to sword/shield and CombatMelee horizontal slice; original source files, crossbow/rogue assets and previous edit history retained. New revision validation pending.
Current revision passed all Go tests, Windows/WebGL builds, Draw-direction regression, native preview, UI/private/practice smoke, and zero-error Unity asset audit. Local server updated to g1-melee-1.
Expanded server-authoritative Knight reach from 1.25 to 1.8 and arc from 120 to 150 degrees; runtime feedback and HUD read the same fetched hero config.
